name: upper
title: Upper arm
orientation: The arm's top face on the bed: the hub, the elbow's fixed ring and its posts all rise from the one flat face, and go on hanging down
description: From the shoulder's hexagon to the elbow's motor. Printed as one part with the elbow's fixed ring, so the elbow's gearbox costs a sun, three planets and an output ring.

neck.rule: The arm's width: its sag and sideways bending are in the chapter

collar.rule: A collar on the arm's underside, on the bearing's inner race, so the outer race doesn't drag

collar_d.rule: On the inner race, clear of the outer

floor.rule: What the screw pulls against: a socket's floor

hex_fit.rule: Across the socket's flats, over the spindle's, printed

arm_gap.rule: Between the fixed ring and the output ring

post_r.rule: Three posts outside the output ring

lobe.rule: The plate reaches out to each post

clip_at.value: thick + gear + arm_gap + gear + arm.flange + clip_gap
clip_at.rule: Each post's tip, where its clip goes on, just past the output's flange

clip_gap.rule: The output turns under the clips with this to spare

pilot.rule: An M3 screw self-tapped into a post

pilot_depth.rule: For an M3 × 10 through a clip

flag_r.rule: The home flag, as far from the shoulder as its switch

flag_h.rule: Down from the arm's underside far enough to reach the switch's lever

switch_a.rule: Round from straight on: the forearm's flag meets the lever at 160° of fold

switch_r.rule: The elbow switch, as far from the elbow as the forearm's flag: outside the posts' radius

switch_high.rule: A post so the switch hangs level with the forearm's flag

post_w.rule: Elbow switch post, along the radius

cos30.rule: A hexagon, across corners to across flats

thick.rule: The arm's thickness, and the elbow motor's plate: 16 lines of 0.42 and 40 layers

bias_d.rule: A hole for a rubber band, or a cable tie to hook one on

bias_1.rule: The shoulder's band, from here to a corner bolt of the base

bias_2.rule: The elbow's band, from here to the forearm
